change_summary: Material model-guidance reversal, with no Jubilee confirmation. Fresh NOAA NGOFS2 21Z guidance changed the Point Clear forward projection from seaward in the prior cycle to shoreward across 1–12 hours: +17.0 m over 1 hour, +132.4 m over 3 hours, +223.5 m over 6 hours and +161.4 m over 12 hours. The matching antecedent nowcast was seaward (-206.7 m over 3 hours and -246.1 m over 6 hours). This is MODEL guidance only, not observed transport or oxygen. The 20:06:00 CDT status, burst and vision identities match; all six expected owner cameras are capture-healthy with 3/3 frames. Only montrose_pier_boat had moderate detectability; the other five low-detectability nighttime views remain UNKNOWN. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope live-player checks used two isolated samples 25.145 and 25.140 seconds apart at 21:08 CDT. Playback positions and rolling endpoints advanced with visible scene progression; Fairhope reported currently playing live, so no Seek to live action was needed. No collecting, clustered searching, handheld lights or feeding-bird signal was visible. Numerous Fairhope parked vehicles at 21:08 were not paired with a visible crowd or water-focused behavior and were not treated as an early-morning precursor. Darkness leaves biological evidence UNKNOWN, and neither Fairhope beach is visible. No credible September 8 first-person Jubilee report was found.
